date.description: ESTYMD arrives as MM/dd/yyyy and is mapped as a strict ISO date, so an unconverted value fails the whole bank document

remove.description: a bad date must drop the value, not the bank: ESTYMD is a strict date, so a raw value would fail the entire document on index

12/31/9999 means 'not ended' on all 4,204 active banks and is junk on 22 inactive ones; loaded as a date it would put banks in nonsense windows, so the value is dropped and the field is genuinely missing

date.description: ENDEFYMD is the closure date the declared-link time window reads; active banks carry a 9999 sentinel here

remove.description: a bad date must drop the value, not the bank: ENDEFYMD is a strict date, so a raw value would fail the entire document on index

lowercase.description: WEB_DOMAIN is the exact-identifier key: the bare host, so http://www.x.com/ and X.COM agree. Copied from WEBADDR; a missing WEBADDR leaves WEB_DOMAIN absent, never empty, because blank must never match blank

gsub.description: strip any path, query, fragment or trailing slash

remove.description: a blank or scheme-only WEBADDR must leave WEB_DOMAIN absent, not an empty string that every blank bank would share

set.description: STREET_LOCAL is the street qualified by its town, so the address signal's exact comparison and its seed need the same street in the same city and state. FDIC lists a bare 'Main Street' for 1,481 banks; compared on ADDRESS alone, each of them matched every other at 1.0 across state lines

LOCALITY is the town and state as one value, so banks in two states' towns of the same name do not share it. No sweep reads it: a same-town rarity signal on it was tried and rejected in tuning (see the README), and the field stays so that trial can be repeated by editing a sweep config rather than reloading. A missing city or state leaves it absent, because blank must never match blank
set.if: ctx.CITY != null && ctx.CITY.toString().trim() != '' && ctx.STALP != null && ctx.STALP.toString().trim() != ''
